newsitem.title: USA: Hawaiian Airlines sees savings from new hub.
newsitem.headline: Hawaiian Airlines sees savings from new hub.

text.p: Hawaiian Airlines said Tuesday it will open a new centralized passenger terminal at its Honolulu base that should save about $1 million in annual operating costs.

The new hub will be in Terminal 2 of the Honolulu International Airport and will consolidate Hawaiian's inter-island, mainland and South Pacific passenger operations into a single operation, the company said.
The carrier said it spent about $2 million to upgrade and double the capacity at the Terminal 2 facility.
